name: Quanta Computer Inc.
blurb: Quanta Computer Inc. is a Taiwanese electronics manufacturer and one of the world's largest notebook computer original design manufacturers (ODMs). The company also produces servers, data center equipment, and other electronic devices for major global brands. With a market capitalization of over NT$1.3 trillion, Quanta is a key player in the global supply chain for computing and cloud infrastructure.
recent: Over the past month, Quanta's stock has risen approximately 9%, reaching a 52-week high of NT$352.50. The company continues to benefit from strong demand for AI servers and cloud computing hardware. No major earnings or news events were reported in the last 30 days.
